Justification and Approval (J&A) when using Simplified Acquisition Procedures for Commercial Products and Services Procurements exceeding the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT), but less than $9M pursuant to 41 U.S.C. 1901, including Brand Name J&A Number: FY26-36

JUSTIFICATION AND APPROVAL FOR OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION

Simplified Procedures for Commercial Products and Services

41 U.S.C. 1901

1. Agency and Contracting Activity. The U.S. Secret Service (USSS), Office of Procurement, proposes to enter into a sole source contract using simplified acquisition procedures (SAP) in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 12.201-1 (FAR Class Deviation 2521) and 41 U.S.C. 1901.

2. Nature and/or description of the action being approved.

(a) Nature of action. The United States Secret Service (USSS) intends to procure on a sole source basis due to an urgent need for engineering support services for its Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) program. This contract action will provide immediate, mission-critical support to address rapidly emerging unmanned aerial threats and ensure the continuity of protective operations. The effort will include system integration, technical support, and operational enhancements to the existing C-UAS environment. This procurement based on urgency is necessary to avoid unacceptable delays and mitigate risks to personnel and protectees during this critical period.

(b) Name and address of the contractor. Assured Momentum Incorporated 8200 Greensboro Drive Suite 900 McLean, VA 22102 (c) Contract type. Firm Fixed Price (FFP) (d) Estimated total value, including options.

Period of Performance Unit Price Total Period Unit of Measure Base Year 12 Months Total Existing contracted support for the C-UAS program will expire on 3/20/2026.

(e) Type of funding. Operations and support funds (O&S) (f) Year of funding. Fiscal Year 2026 (g) Solicitation number. 70US0926Q70092661 (h) Background information about the requirement.

12.5.2025 v.1.0 Justification and Approval (J&A) when using Simplified Acquisition Procedures for Commercial Products and Services Procurements exceeding the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT), but less than $9M pursuant to 41 U.S.C. 1901, including Brand Name The USSS is responsible for protecting high-profile government officials and designated protectees against a range of evolving threats. In recent years, the proliferation of unmanned aerial systems (UAS) has introduced new risks to secure environments and protective operations. To counter these threats, USSS has implemented a specialized C-UAS program, which requires ongoing engineering support to maintain, enhance, and rapidly adapt system capabilities. The current requirement arises from rapidly emerging UAS-related threats and the urgent need to ensure the effectiveness and readiness of C-UAS assets in support of critical mission objectives.

3. Description of Supplies/Services.

The requirement is to acquire urgent engineering support services for the USSS’ C-UAS program. The objectives of this contract are to: • Ensure C-UAS systems operate securely, effectively, and reliably across a wide range of complex and dynamic operational environments, addressing emerging threats while maintaining compliance with stringent cybersecurity and National Security System (NSS) standards. • Enhance system integration and validation practices through rigorous testing, evaluation, and continuous improvement methodologies to guarantee seamless interoperability and mission readiness. • Leverage advanced analytics and data-driven insights to continuously assess mission and system performance, identify operational gaps, and inform decision-making processes for capability enhancements. • Maintain transparency, accountability, and strategic alignment through disciplined program management, comprehensive risk oversight, and proactive stakeholder engagement, ensuring contract activities remain mission-focused, cost-effective, and responsive to Government priorities.

4. Identification of the authority.

41 U.S.C. 1901, using SAP up to $9M as authorized and implemented by FAR 12.102(b) (FAR Class Deviation 25-21).

5. Identification of Exception to the Buy American Statute. Not Applicable

6. Demonstration that the proposed contractor’s unique qualifications or the nature of the acquisition requires use of the authority cited.

12.5.2025 v.1.0 Justification and Approval (J&A) when using Simplified Acquisition Procedures for Commercial Products and Services Procurements exceeding the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT), but less than $9M pursuant to 41 U.S.C. 1901, including Brand Name (a) Circumstances for Not Using Full and Open Competition:

Urgency - An urgent and compelling need exists, and following the procedures to compete the requirement would result in unacceptable delays The urgency of this acquisition is driven by a rapidly evolving threat landscape and imminent operational demands. This is not the result of poor planning or oversight; it is a direct response to unpredictable, emergent threats that require immediate mitigation Routine competitive acquisition procedures would introduce significant delays, potentially compromising the effectiveness of protective operations during a period of heightened risk. The mission-critical nature of these services means any delay could result in reduced situational awareness, degraded operational effectiveness, and increased risk to personnel and protectees.

To ensure compliance with acquisition regulations, a competitive contract is already planned and in progress for the larger, ongoing requirement. The effective period of this urgent sole source award will be strictly limited to the minimum time necessary to transition to a competed contract, with clear milestones in place to facilitate timely and fair competition for future support. Awarding this urgent procurement to Assured Momentum will enable a structured and effective transition period, allowing for critical knowledge transfer to the competitively awarded vendor. This approach ensures continuity of operations, minimizes disruptions, and preserves mission effectiveness, supporting a seamless handover of responsibilities in support of USSS protective operations.

(b) Events Leading to the Situation and Segregation for Competition:

12.5.2025 v.1.0 Justification and Approval (J&A) when using Simplified Acquisition Procedures for Commercial Products and Services Procurements exceeding the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT), but less than $9M pursuant to 41 U.S.C. 1901, including Brand Name This urgent requirement is the direct result of a sudden escalation in unmanned aerial threats ████████████████████████████████████████████ █████████████████████████████████ The urgency is not attributable to poor planning, but to the unpredictable and emergent nature of the threat environment. USSS has consistently engaged in market research and competitive procurement strategies for C-UAS support; however, the current situation demands immediate action that cannot be met through routine competitive procedures. No portion of the work can be reasonably segregated to allow for competition, as the requirement is for fully integrated engineering support across the entire C-UAS system.

(c) Alternatives Considered and Why They Will Not Work:

Alternatives, including competing the requirement among other vendors, were considered and rejected. These options would necessitate extensive onboarding, training, and integration efforts, resulting in unacceptable delays and operational risks. Vendors without prior, direct experience with the USSS C-UAS system lack the system-specific expertise necessary for immediate and effective support during this critical period.

(d) Impact to the Mission if the J&A Is Not Approved:

Failure to approve this J&A and procure the required urgent services from Assured Momentum will result in a significant and immediate degradation of C-UAS operational effectiveness. This would reduce situational awareness, increase risk to personnel and protectees, and potentially result in mission failure ██████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████ ████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████████ (e) Nonavailability Exception to the Buy American Statute:

This requirement does not invoke the nonavailability exception to the Buy American statute.

7. Description of efforts made to ensure that offers are solicited from as many potential sources as is practicable, including whether a notice was or will be publicized as required by FAR 5.101 (FAR Class Deviation 25-17) and, if not, which exception under FAR 5.101(b) (FAR Class Deviation 25-17) applies.

Efforts to ensure that offers were solicited from as many potential sources as practicable included conducting market research and reviewing acquisition history to identify potential sources for this urgent requirement. Additionally, an acquisition planning forecast was released for the competed procurement to maximize transparency and encourage broader industry participation. Despite the competitive marketplace, due to the urgency of this requirement, Assured Momentum was found with the proven expertise and immediate operational readiness needed to fulfill the USSS’ mission-critical needs.

The announcement of this proposed contract action will not be posted due to the applicable exemption at FAR 5.101(b)(2), FAR 5.201(b)(1), and FAR 5.301(b). This justification will be posted within 30 days of contract award in accordance with FAR 12.301(a)(2)/FAR 6.301.

12.5.2025 v.1.0 Justification and Approval (J&A) when using Simplified Acquisition Procedures for Commercial Products and Services Procurements exceeding the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT), but less than $9M pursuant to 41 U.S.C. 1901, including Brand Name

8. Determination by the contracting officer that the anticipated cost to the Government will be fair and reasonable.

The contracting officer determines that the anticipated costs for this requirement will be fair and reasonable based on historical prices paid for similar services under prior USSS contracts. These prior acquisitions were thoroughly evaluated and found to be fair and reasonable at the time of award.

9. Description of market research.

Market research was conducted from January 2026 to the present and included a review of acquisition history, prior contract performance, and an overall assessment of the commercial marketplace for engineering support services. Historical pricing paid for similar C-UAS engineering support under previous USSS contracts was reviewed. Market research confirmed that Assured Momentum Incorporated possesses the capability and immediate operational readiness required to meet the urgent needs of the USSS. Additionally, a Request for Information (RFI) was published for the upcoming competed effort, and the results will be utilized to inform the acquisition strategy for the follow-on competitive requirement.

10. Any other facts supporting the use of other than full and open competition.

No additional facts beyond those already stated support the use of other than full and open competition for this requirement.

11. A listing of the sources, if any that expressed, in writing, an interest in the acquisition.

While sources have expressed interest in this requirement by responding to the Requests for Information, the responses from these sources will be considered during the competed follow-on acquisition due to the urgency of this requirement.

12. A statement of the actions, if any, the agency may take to remove or overcome any barriers to competition before any subsequent acquisition for supplies or services required.

To remove barriers to competition and increase industry participation in future acquisitions, the agency is actively planning and conducting extensive market research into a competed procurement. RFIs were released to identify interested vendors and gather market feedback. These actions are intended to maximize competition and ensure broad industry engagement for subsequent acquisitions of these services.
